entities.name: UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE requests establishment of a PDU session and can indicate support for port management information container transfer.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify an established PDU session, used for exchanging port management information containers.

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network to modify an established PDU session, used for exchanging port management information containers.

entities.name: Port management information container
entities.description: Container exchanged between DS-TT and TSN AF/TSCTSF for user plane node management.

entities.name: DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address
entities.description: MAC address provided by UE during PDU session establishment if PDU session type is Ethernet.

entities.name: UE-DS-TT residence time
entities.description: Residence time information provided by UE to network if available during PDU session establishment.

entities.name: UE supports transfer of port management information containers
entities.description: Condition where UE indicates support for port management information container transfer during PDU session establishment.

entities.name: UE forwards port management information container to DS-TT
entities.description: Behavior where UE receiving port management information container from network shall forward it to DS-TT.

entities.name: SMF handles port management information container from UE
entities.description: Behavior where SMF receiving port management information container from UE operates as specified in TS 23.502.

relations.description: UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure is guarded by condition that UE supports port management information container transfer.
UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure contains DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address IE.
UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure contains port management information container IE.
UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure contains UE-DS-TT residence time IE.
UE-requested PDU session modification procedure contains port management information container IE.
Network-requested PDU session modification procedure contains port management information container IE.
Condition that UE supports port management container transfer establishes UE forwarding behavior.
Condition that UE supports port management container transfer establishes SMF handling behavior.
